meaning: Ordered control samples of projected path arclength and executed/target speed from B. Repeated arclength retained with control ordinal because acceleration/pose are stateful; not native waypoint time or a universal open-loop v(s).

speed_rule.rule: target=clip(0.4/abs(kappa_PP),0.05,0.2), zero kappa target0.2. Choose closest target within previous-v +/-0.5/9. omega=clip(v*kappa,-0.4,0.4). Continue when clipped. Same RAW+Speed/Graphv3.
speed_rule.initial_v: Previous actual executed command one 9Hz tick before B; no reset to target speed
speed_rule.endpoint: Endpoint completion terminates counterfactual before issuing v=0, not in-place recovery. H_switch completion before requested horizon is a stop/truncation and cannot qualify. H_chunk natural endpoint completion is reported separately.
